name: R089-sleep-talk-encore
why: Challenge 2, trainer 100. Player Jumpluff (334) Sleep Powders the lead Seaking (333, Sleep Talk); Wobbuffet (290) switches in and Encores the sleeping Seaking, whose last move is Sleep Talk: its next Sleep Talk finds no move the Encore allows and fails. Haunter (284) takes over after the Encore so the battle ends (Wobbuffet alone cannot kill: the first version hit the frame budget).
